summary: Disables expensive behaviours, renderers or objects beyond a distance, and re-enables them in range.
overview: LOD-lite without an LOD Group: put it on anything expensive that does not need to run when far away — a particle system, an AI's own Update, a complex animator — and it disables the targets past a threshold, re-enabling them when the reference point comes back.
useCases: Turning off distant particle systems and animators in a large scene.
Stopping far-away AI thinking without unloading it.
A cheap first pass at scene cost before committing to LOD groups or streaming.

params.tuning: Usually the camera or the player. Left empty it falls back to the main camera, which is wrong the moment you have a cinematic camera too.
Seconds between checks, not frames. Raise it for many cullers — the check itself is the cost you are trying to avoid.
One threshold with no hysteresis, so an object sitting exactly at the boundary toggles repeatedly.

gotchas.title: Disabling a Behaviour is not free to undo
gotchas.body: Re-enabling a particle system or animator restarts it from its current state, which can look like a pop. For anything visually continuous, cull the renderer rather than the behaviour.

gotchas.title: No hysteresis at the boundary
gotchas.body: An object hovering at exactly cullDistance flips on and off each check. Give it a margin by culling a little further out than you think you need.
